newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Oct 31.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Oct 31.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Thursday:
* On Wednesday, the Dow Jones dropped 13.79 points to 5,993.23. PLDT's ADR edged up by $ 1/2 to $59 5/8.
* The peso closed at 26.285 to a U.S.dollar from 26.284.
* The Philippine Stock Exchange index closed at 2,927.30, up 22.89.
* The Philippine interbank call loan rate at 11.0625 pct from 11.09375 percent.

* Stock brokerage Angping Securities recommended "take profits" on liquor manufacturer La Tondena Distillers after the firm announced on Wednesday that nine months profits rose by 51 percent to 581.463 million pesos. Angping said the income was boosted by a non-recurring gain from the sale of its Tondo plant which boosted its 1996 third quarter income by 238.3 million pesos. Thus, stripped of one-time gains, net earnings actually declined 3.6 percent, Angping said.

* Diversified firm Ayala Corp's announcement on Wednesday of a 32 percent rise in net profits to 4.95 billion pesos in the first nine months led to expectations full year profits would be over six billion pesos, analysts said.
* The Philippines declared a half-day holiday for all government offices on Thursday ahead of Friday's All Saints Day holiday. But the Central Bank said normal banking hours would be observed.
* C&P Homes said on Wednesday its nine-mth net rose to 2.007 billion pesos from 1.421 billion pesos.
